h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Katni

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Katni

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Katni

c: Single or double machines is a common question from buyers in a town like Katni, where budgets are fixed and the park has to serve a lot of people. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, railway and industrial colonies, housing societies and municipal parks in Katni. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 920 km away, and reach Madhya Pradesh by road.

A double machine costs more than a single, but it serves two people on one frame and one footing. Where people come in groups, doubles usually work out better. Where use is spread through the day, singles let you cover more exercises. Katni has hot summers and a good monsoon. We install through our own team or a dealer in central India. Tell us how busy your site gets, and we will suggest the right mix on a layout drawing.

items.q: Should we buy single or double outdoor gym machines?
items.a: Doubles suit sites where people arrive in groups, since two can train at once on one frame. Singles let you cover more types of exercise within a budget.

items.q: How is the equipment installed in Katni?
items.a: Our own team or a dealer in central India fixes each machine as per the layout drawing, on a grouted or self-standing base to suit the ground.

items.q: How far is Katni from your factory?
items.a: About 920 km by road from our factory in Vasai. We dispatch from there after you approve the layout and quote.
